title: Payment Conduct Share of a Lease Term Agreement Concession Recapture — Training Questions
content:
**Rule.** The concession recapture booked on a lease-break request against a Lease Term Agreement keeps a conduct share of the unearned concession, set by the lease's payment record: a lease with no returned payment dated fewer than 12 full calendar months before the handling date and with ACH autopay enrolled keeps 80 percent; a lease with no such returned payment and without autopay enrolled keeps 90 percent; a lease with such a returned payment keeps the whole. The share multiplies the unearned concession, and no figure is rounded before the recapture itself.

**Q. What is a returned payment?** A payment on the Apartment Home Lease that the bank or card network returned (dishonoured), dated by the date of the return.

**Q. Which autopay is read?** Recurring ACH autopay enrolled on the Apartment Home Lease.

| Returned payment in the 12-month span | ACH autopay enrolled | Conduct share kept |
|---|---|---|
| none | yes | 80 percent (0.80) |
| none | no | 90 percent (0.90) |
| one or more | yes or no | the whole (100 percent) |

**Q. Where is the edge of the span? (hypothetical dates)** Handling date 5 April: a return dated 6 April of the previous year is inside the span; one dated 5 April of the previous year is outside it.

**Q. A worked figure? (hypothetical)** An unearned concession of 500.00 dollars on an autopay lease with no return in the span keeps 80 percent: 400.00 dollars.
